observations.grouping_keys: Same platform (amazon), action (search), market (United States, from task), currency (USD), and capture time. Capacity differs on every row and comes from title text only, so each capacity is its own group.

interpretation: Only SYNTH00001 passes both stated filters: its 24 USD listed price is within the 28 USD ceiling (24 <= 28) and it is in stock.

SYNTH00002 is in stock but exceeds the ceiling by 2 USD (30 > 28). Its 4.8/5 rating comes from 30 ratings, against 4.5/5 from 120 ratings for SYNTH00001 (a 4x larger base), and it is a different capacity, so the rating gap is weak evidence of better quality.
SYNTH00003 is out of stock and returned no price or rating. Its rating_count of 0 means no ratings were counted, not a low score, and it cannot be checked against the price ceiling.
The titles state three different capacities (32 oz, 750 ml, 24 oz). Capacity is title text rather than a structured field, so no size-adjusted value comparison is made.
Listed retail prices are not procurement costs; nothing here supports margin, sales, or demand claims.

missing_values.null_vs_zero: SYNTH00003 rating_count is a returned 0; its price, rating, rating_scale, and features were not returned. Neither is treated as a zero price or a zero rating.

recommendations.rationale: The only row meeting both stated criteria (listed price <= 28 USD and in stock).
tradeoffs: SYNTH00002: in stock and rated 4.8/5 on 30 ratings, but 2 USD over the ceiling and a different capacity (750 ml).
SYNTH00003: 24 oz, but out of stock with no returned price or rating.
recommendations.conditional: If the ceiling rises to at least 30 USD, SYNTH00002 also passes the filters. If a specific capacity is required, the shortlist changes: 32 oz keeps SYNTH00001; 750 ml leaves only SYNTH00002, which is over the current ceiling; 24 oz leaves only SYNTH00003, which needs a returned price and stock first.
